verdict.rationale: HumanLayer supports running automation sessions from CI (`humanlayer automation run`) and can open draft PRs from a session's diff/GitHub tab, and GitHub integration links tasks to issues—so the building blocks for a CI-triggered fix-and-PR flow exist. However there is no direct evidence of automatic diagnosis of failed CI logs/errors or a documented end-to-end 'CI failure → agent diagnosis → PR' pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI-failure-detection/diagnosis workflow docs, example of a failing pipeline auto-triggering a session, and confirmation the resulting PR addresses the CI failure specifically.
